$schema_note: HAR-18 fourth-task admission packet slice: Peter-only registration checklist and contract specification

peter_registration_gate.factory_write_restriction: Factory, subagents, and automated runners are strictly prohibited from writing to library/registry. Any automated modification of library/registry violates Eval Lab trust and admission policy.
peter_registration_gate.cli_command: After a candidate record exists: evallab registry register action-memory-dl-semantic-distractor-16384-s42 --actor "Peter Makhnatch" --certification-packet research/registration/candidates/<candidate_id>/certification.json
registration_invariants: actor must be non-empty and specify approving human actor (--actor 'Peter Makhnatch')
task must already exist as candidate record in library/registry or be promoted via explicit candidate flow
certification envelope state must be 'bound' for any new task registration (legacy_missing is prohibited for new tasks)
task package directory must exist at task_path with all components: task.toml, instruction, environment, and verifier
on-disk package digests must match record.digests byte-for-byte across all component hashes
control evidence must be committed and present with oracle.reward == 1.0 and nop.reward == 0.0
control evidence paths, trial locks, and harbor_task_digests must match current disk package bytes
state transitions strictly to 'registered', approved_by becomes actor, approved_at is recorded in UTC, and state_reason is set to null

har14_cohort_freeze_gate.rule: HAR-14 active evaluation cohort remains frozen until Peter completes explicit registration of the fourth-slot task.
cohort_constraints: dl-semantic-distractor-16384-s42 must NOT be referenced in active experiment matrices or evaluation specs prior to registration.
The fourth slot remains strictly in candidate/staged status; no automated runner or benchmark dispatch may consume it as a registered task.
ExperimentSpec task_ref resolution via TaskRegistry.resolve_spec_task() strictly raises TaskNotRegisteredError if referenced before state=='registered'.
Peter registration is the gating event that unfreezes the evaluation cohort to admit the fourth task alongside existing cohort members.

task_id.description: Canonical lowercase hyphenated task identifier matching materializer cell naming (3-80 chars).

version.description: Semantic version of the task package.

task_path.value: derived/harbor-tasks/action-memory-dose-ladder/<dose_ladder_contract_digest>/action-memory-dl-semantic-distractor-16384-s42-seed42 until Integration stages a review path
task_path.description: Repository-relative path to task package directory; no leading slash, no '..'.

digests.description: Canonical SHA-256 digests of all package files and the aggregate package directory.

source_ref.description: External repository commit hash or release tag; null for local/synthetic tasks.

license.description: License identifier governing task package code and data.

provenance_zone.description: Zone classification; 03-synthetic for dose-ladder generated tasks.

is_synthetic.description: Flag marking whether the task is synthetically generated.

limits.description: Execution limits enforcing runtime constraints (timeout 1-21600 seconds, memory, CPUs).

control_evidence.description: Promoted oracle and nop evidence references; required when state is registered.

certification.description: Workbench certification packet envelope; state must be 'bound' for new registrations.

state.description: Admission state; 'registered' upon completion of Peter's approval.

allowed_uses.description: Permitted operational uses; must include 'measurement' for evaluation cohort.

value.basis: synthetically generated Action Memory dose-ladder cell; not in pretrain data

human_minutes.description: Expert human completion time estimate in minutes.

approved_by.description: Approving human actor; strictly required when state == 'registered'.

approved_at.description: Timestamp of Peter's approval; strictly required when state == 'registered'.

state_reason.description: Machine-readable reason for non-registered states; must be null when state == 'registered'.

oracle_contract.execution_notes: Native Harbor oracle executes against the materialized package with live FastMCP sidecar container (solve_via_mcp) or direct solver (solve_direct). Reward must equal 1.0 exactly.

nop_contract.execution_notes: NOP agent takes zero action or immediate return; verifier must score exactly 0.0 with no leakage or default-pass bugs.

evidence_verification_checks: evidence_path must be relative to repo and begin with 'research/evidence/runs/'
evidence result.json must exist and its SHA-256 match evidence_digest
trial lock task.lock.json must exist and its SHA-256 match lock_digest
evidence ref task_id and task_version must match TaskRegistryRecord
evidence ref task_digests must match TaskRegistryRecord.digests
harbor_task_digest must match fresh harbor_task_digest() computed from on-disk package
trial lock task version or digest must match registered package

task_correctness.reason: oracle runs succeeded under target environment

verifier_soundness.reason: nop and invalid probes rejected with reward 0.0

solvability.reason: demonstrated solvable by oracle within 3 step budget

difficulty_calibration.reason: 16k semantic distractor calibrated for context/delegation discrimination

realism_review.reason: Action Memory MCP pattern reflects production tool-assisted agent workload

envelope_invariants: packet_path must stay repo-relative, start with 'research/registration/candidates/', and end in '/certification.json'
package_digest in envelope must match TaskRegistryRecord.digests.package exactly
generator_identity and validator_identity must be distinct (self-check prohibition)
stored certification envelope in TaskRegistryRecord must match re-read packet bytes byte-for-byte

step_1_staging.action: Execute scripts/mcp_funcdag/ensure_wheelhouse.py to stage FastMCP 3.4.7 wheels at /tmp/fastmcp3_wheelhouse and generate resolver-provenance.json.

step_2_materialization.action: Call materialize_dose_ladder_cell(seed=42, dose_bytes=16384, arm='semantic_distractor'). Do not pass a cell_id string or plan_only. Default output is derived/harbor-tasks/action-memory-dose-ladder/<digest>/action-memory-dl-semantic-distractor-16384-s42-seed42.
step_2_materialization.prerequisite: Step 1 complete with verified wheels and provenance.

step_3_control_evidence.action: Run native Harbor oracle and nop trials on materialized task package to collect durable evidence under research/evidence/runs/.
step_3_control_evidence.verification: Confirm oracle reward == 1.0 and nop reward == 0.0.

step_4_certification_packet.action: Run task_workbench certification suite to produce research/registration/candidates/candidate-<id>/certification.json.
step_4_certification_packet.verification: All check vector booleans pass; envelope state is 'bound'.

step_5_candidate_record.action: evallab registry promote --task-path <materialized package> to create library/registry/action-memory-dl-semantic-distractor-16384-s42.json as state=candidate. Factory must not write that file.
step_5_candidate_record.result: Candidate record exists on disk; register_task requires this file.

step_6_peter_registration.result: Transitions the existing candidate record to state='registered'. Does not create the file from nothing. HAR-14 freeze may then add this task by a new Factory cohort revision, not by rewriting history.
